subject: Request: Compliance-linked POC credits for Horizon Health VPC trial
messages:
From: Dr. Priya Malhotra <priya@horizonhealth.ai>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: john.ellis@horizonhealth.ai, procurement@horizonhealth.ai
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Interest in Private VPC POC — credits question

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We want to run a 45-day Private VPC POC (sensitive PHI-processing workloads) to evaluate Redwood for a clinical summarization pipeline. Our security & procurement teams have a few gating items before we can spin up the environment.

Short ask: would Redwood consider promotional credits or a trial credit extension tied to receiving SOC2 evidence + a signed data handling addendum? Horizon is prepared to execute an NDA and sign a brief waiver if needed. The procurement team prefers arrangement options:
- Full credits for the 45-day POC (estimate ~$10-15k)
- Or a partial credit + shorter billing hold until we verify controls

I attached the initial Security Assessment (internal) and a short questionnaire — happy to walk through with your SecOps.

[Attachment: Horizon_Security_SA.xlsx]

Best,
Priya
Dr. Priya Malhotra
Director of Clinical AI, Horizon Health

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Priya Malhotra <priya@horizonhealth.ai>
Cc: john.ellis@horizonhealth.ai, procurement@horizonhealth.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 12:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interest in Private VPC POC — credits question

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear ask and for sharing the assessment. Excited to move forward on the VPC POC.

High-level response: we can approve a compliance-contingent credit package for POCs that meet our minimum security checklist. Typical path here is:
1) Exchange SOC2 summary + KMS/crypto commitments
2) Sign a short POC addendum (we can provide) that limits scope and duration
3) Redwood provisions a Private VPC trial slot and issues promotional credits usable during the POC period

Can you confirm the estimated token/compute spend you expect for the 45 days? If the figure you gave (~$12k) is accurate, I can propose a one-time $12,000 promotional credit contingent on receipt of: SOC2 snapshot, completed intake questionnaire, and a signed POC addendum.

Looping in Aditya (sales engineer) and John (your CISO) on scheduling a 30-min SecOps sync this week to go over KMS, retention, and network egress rules.

Next steps: 1) Aditya to review the attached SA, 2) Grace from CS to own the POC onboarding timeline, 3) Legal/Finance to approve the credit terms (I will escalate).

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Interest in Private VPC POC — credits question

Team — forwarding: Horizon Health (clinical AI) is asking for compliance-linked credits for a 45-day Private VPC POC. Key asks from customer: SOC2 evidence, POC addendum, and a credit amount of ~$12k.

Questions for internal review:
- Can we approve a $12k promotional credit contingent on SOC2 snapshot + signed POC addendum?
- Any additional constraints legal/finance want on credits (expiry, clawback if abused)?
- Security checklist: KMS required? Audit logs retention minimum?

Notes: Horizon will process PHI in the environment; they will need VPC-only access and customer-managed keys. 

Appreciate quick turnaround — procurement wants a formal answer by EOD tomorrow.

—K

From: aditya.rao@redwood.com <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 11:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Interest in Private VPC POC — credits question

Thanks for the ping. I pulled the attachment and summarized technical constraints below after a quick pass: 
- SOC2 snapshot: acceptable for initial POC gating (we should capture the scope and date).
- KMS: support customer-managed keys in Private (OK), require KMS key policy review.
- Data retention: default logs retained 90 days; for Horizon we can set retention policy to 30 days if requested but recommend 90 for auditability.
- Network: VPC-only with allowed egress to approved telemetry endpoints; no public endpoints for model endpoints.

Recommendation: approve the $12k promotional credit subject to the following terms:
- Credit valid for 60 days from issuance, only usable against resources in the provisioned Private VPC for DEAL-7842
- Customer must provide the SOC2 summary (pdf) and sign a short POC addendum specifying: scope, retention, and KMS usage
- If customer escalates to production before controls are validated, credits will be paused and any overage billed at list price (standard clawback language)

I attached a one-page SOC2 snapshot reference (we requested from platform team) to help legal.

[Attachment: SOC2-snapshot.pdf]

If legal/finance are OK with the terms below I think we can offer the credit and schedule the DocuSign for the addendum.

- Aditya
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

Subject: Approved: Compliance-contingent POC credit and next steps

- Validity: issued once SOC2 snapshot and completed intake questionnaire are received; credit usable for 60 days on the provisioned Private VPC only
- Conditions: customer-managed KMS enabled, signed POC addendum (DocuSign link below), and no early production escalation without renewed security sign-off

2) Review and sign the POC addendum (DocuSign).
3) Schedule the SecOps sync with Aditya — suggested slots: Thu 10:00–11:00 or Fri 14:00–15:00 PT.
